description: Lists every collection in the Directus instance with its metadata, so the data model can be discovered before anything is read or written. Start here when the collection name is unknown; use get_collection_schema for the fields of one collection and get_collection_items to read its rows. Folders (grouping elements with no table behind them) and inactive collections (Directus 12.4 refuses to read or write their contents) are flagged in the result. System collections are omitted unless include_system is true. Returns one entry per collection with its name, metadata and those flags.
name: list_collections
